faq: What is Radhakishan Damani's portfolio worth?

His disclosed holdings were valued at about ₹1.06 lakh crore after the September 2026 filings on Trendlyne, and up to about ₹1.61 lakh crore on trackers that also count family company holdings. Most of it is his DMart stake.
What did Radhakishan Damani buy recently?
His September 2026 filings show two new stakes: 1.58% of the National Stock Exchange (about ₹6,967 crore) and 1.16% of Horizon Industrial Parks.
No 2026 bulk or block deals by him were found. His changes are mostly visible in quarterly shareholding filings.
How do you know the prices?
Prices are exact only for bulk and block deals, which the exchanges publish daily. Quarterly filings show shares held but not the price paid, so those gains are shown as not public or estimated.
